name: Springwater Corridor (Gresham Main City Park)
notes: Flat paved rail-trail; head east toward Boring or west along Johnson Creek.

name: Gresham Butte Saddle Trail
notes: Steep switchbacks through second-growth forest; muddy in winter.

name: Powell Butte Nature Park
notes: Summit meadow with Mt. Hood views on clear days; mixed-use trails.

name: Lewis and Clark State Recreation Site
notes: Short Oak Trail loop at the mouth of the Sandy River.

name: Oxbow Regional Park
notes: Old-growth forest along the Sandy River; Metro parking fee. No dogs.

name: Mt. Talbert Nature Park
notes: 4-mile loop climbing an extinct volcano; quiet on weekdays. No dogs.

name: Latourell Falls Loop
notes: 2.4-mile loop past upper and lower falls; first waterfall on the Historic Highway.

name: Angel's Rest Trail
notes: ~1,500 ft gain in 2.4 mi to an exposed bluff over the Columbia. Go early.

name: Multnomah–Wahkeena Falls Loop
notes: 5-mile loop with ~1,600 ft gain. Seasonal timed-entry permits may apply.

name: Beacon Rock Summit Trail
notes: Short but exposed switchbacks with railings; Discover Pass required (WA).

name: Boccherini's Coffee & Tea House
notes: Downtown Gresham coffeehouse with pastries and frequent live music.

name: Tortillería y Tienda de León
notes: Grocery-counter guisados, house-made tortillas and tamales.

name: McMenamins Edgefield
notes: Sprawling former poor farm with pubs, gardens and a concert lawn.

name: Tad's Chicken 'n Dumplins
notes: Old-school roadhouse on the Sandy River since the 1920s.

name: Sugarpine Drive-In
notes: Riverside drive-in known for soft serve sundaes; good post-Gorge stop.

name: Ya Hala Lebanese Cuisine
notes: Montavilla Lebanese restaurant with an attached market.

name: HK Cafe
notes: Cart-style dim sum on 82nd; busy weekend mornings.

name: Pho Oregon
notes: Big bowls of pho on NE 82nd; quick service.

name: Apizza Scholls
notes: New Haven–leaning pies on Hawthorne; reserve ahead.

name: Multnomah Falls Lodge
notes: 1925 stone lodge at the base of the falls; pairs with the loop hike.
